dialogue.content: こんにちは今日はよろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.English: Hello. I look forward to working with you today.

dialogue.content: よろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.English: Thank you for having me.

dialogue.content: お時間少し早いですが、始めさせて頂いてよろしいでしょうか？時間どおりの方がよろしいですか？
dialogue.English: We're a little early; is it alright if we begin now? Or would you prefer to start on time?

dialogue.content: どちらでも構いません。お任せします。
dialogue.English: Either is fine with me. I'll leave it up to you.

dialogue.content: ありがとございます。では、はじめさせてください。
dialogue.English: Thank you. Then, let's begin.

dialogue.content: よろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.English: Yes, please.

dialogue.content: よろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: こんにちは、相談員ですよろしくお願いいたします
dialogue.English: Hello, I'm the counselor. I look forward to working with you.

dialogue.content: お願いいたします。
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: よろしければニックネームでかまいませんので、なんとお呼びすれば良いか教えていただけますか？
dialogue.English: If you'd like, you can use a nickname. Could you please tell me what you would like me to call you?

dialogue.content: みどりと申します。
dialogue.English: You can call me Midori.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: みどりさん、今日はどのようなご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.English: Midori, what would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.content: 結婚式を控えていたのですが、キャンセルになり、結婚することを考え直しています。
dialogue.English: I had a wedding coming up, but it was canceled, and now I'm rethinking getting married.

dialogue.content: 色々考えていると何が良いのか
dialogue.English: The more I think about it, the less sure I am about what's best.

dialogue.content: ご結婚式がキャンセルですか・・・どのような事でキャンセルになられたのですか？
dialogue.English: Your wedding was canceled... May I ask why it was canceled?

dialogue.content: コロナが原因で式場はキャンセルしました。
dialogue.English: We canceled the venue because of COVID.

dialogue.content: 入籍はしていません。
dialogue.English: We haven't officially registered our marriage yet.

dialogue.content: そうでしたかそれでキャンセルを機に色々お考え始めてらっしゃるのですね
dialogue.English: I see. And the cancellation prompted you to start rethinking various things.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 重要な決断をなさろうとしていらっしゃるわけですね・・
dialogue.English: It sounds like you're facing a very important decision.

dialogue.content: そういうことになりますね。
dialogue.English: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.content: お迷いになれていらっしゃるのは具体的にどのようなことなのですか？
dialogue.English: Specifically, what are you feeling uncertain about?

dialogue.content: 私の仕事はこれまでどおりなのですが
dialogue.English: My job is the same as before, but...

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 彼の仕事がガラっと変わってしまい
dialogue.English: His work has changed drastically, and...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 彼のお母様が体調を崩し入院してしまい
dialogue.English: His mother fell ill and was hospitalized, and...

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: この数ヶ月で色々な状況が変わってしまい
dialogue.English: A lot has changed over the past few months, and...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I understand.

dialogue.content: 彼を支えていけるのかが一番の不安です
dialogue.English: My biggest worry is whether I can support him through all of this.

dialogue.content: そうだったのですねそれは大きな出来事の変化が大変ですね
dialogue.English: I understand. Those are significant changes, and that's a lot to handle.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 彼氏さんのお仕事の変化は、職場や収入などがお迷いの原因ですか？
dialogue.English: Regarding the change in your fiancé's job, are you concerned about his workplace or income?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 収入の面を考えると不安になるのは当然ですよね
dialogue.English: It's only natural to feel anxious when you think about finances.

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: That's true.

dialogue.content: 転職も考えているようですが
dialogue.English: It seems he's considering changing jobs, but...

dialogue.content: 厳しそうですし
dialogue.English: But it looks like it will be difficult.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか彼氏さんも悩みどころなのですね
dialogue.English: I see. So your fiancé is in a difficult position as well.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 因みに、
dialogue.English: By the way,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes?

dialogue.content: 彼氏さんのお母さまの看護などには関わられておられるのですか？
dialogue.English: Are you involved in caring for your fiancé's mother?

dialogue.content: それも
dialogue.English: That's another thing...

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: M-hm.

dialogue.content: まだ結婚していない状況でどこまで関わったら良いのか
dialogue.English: I'm not sure how involved I should be, since we're not married yet.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: I understand.

dialogue.content: 病院には行けないのですが
dialogue.English: I can't visit her in the hospital, but...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Right.

dialogue.content: 彼のお父様がお一人で暮らしていますので、そちらも心配です。
dialogue.English: ...and his father is living alone, so I'm worried about him too.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか本当に色々と考えてしまうことばかりですね
dialogue.English: I see. There really is so much for you to think about.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 彼の妹が
dialogue.English: His younger sister...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes?

dialogue.content: よくやっていると思います
dialogue.English: I think she is doing a lot to help.

dialogue.content: それはよい親子関係でよかったですね
dialogue.English: That's good to hear—they seem to have a positive family relationship.

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: Yes, it is.

dialogue.content: 彼氏さんとはお付き合いして何年くらいなのですか？
dialogue.English: How many years have you and your fiancé been together?

dialogue.content: 3年くらいです
dialogue.English: About three years.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね交際から結婚に至るにはどのような事がきっかけだったのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see. What led you from dating to deciding to marry?

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: Let me see...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: M-hm.

dialogue.content: 結婚の決め手は一緒にいて自分らしく居られたことです。
dialogue.English: The deciding factor for marriage was that I could be myself when I was with him.

dialogue.content: それは大事なことですよねご自分らしくいられるのは素敵です
dialogue.English: That's very important, isn't it? It's wonderful that you can be yourself.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 結婚して彼の仕事を手伝う予定でした
dialogue.English: I was planning to help with his work after we got married.

dialogue.content: そうだったのですねですが、転職なさってしまった・・・
dialogue.English: I see. But he ended up changing jobs...

dialogue.content: 転職は考え中です
dialogue.English: He's still thinking about changing jobs.

dialogue.content: 私も今の仕事は辞めていません
dialogue.English: And I haven't quit my current job either.

dialogue.content: あ、すみませんでした職場の変化というのは？
dialogue.English: Oh, I apologize. What did you mean by the change in his workplace?

dialogue.content: 彼氏さんの
dialogue.English: Your fiancé's.

dialogue.content: いいえ
dialogue.English: No.

dialogue.content: コロナで
dialogue.English: Because of COVID,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: お店を改装したり、感染予防対策で人数制限したりといったところです
dialogue.English: They renovated the shop and limited the number of customers as infection-control measures.

dialogue.content: コロナの影響で、職場自体が、ガラッと変わってしまったという事だったのですね
dialogue.English: So due to the impact of COVID, the workplace itself changed drastically.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 説明不足ですみません
dialogue.English: I'm sorry for not explaining it well.

dialogue.content: いえ、こちらの早とちりでした申し訳ないです
dialogue.English: No, I jumped to conclusions. I apologize.

dialogue.content: 彼氏さんとは、
dialogue.English: With your fiancé,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes?

dialogue.content: お付き合いの中でどのようなお二人の仲なのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: How would you describe your relationship as a couple?

dialogue.content: どのように答えたら良いのか
dialogue.English: I'm not sure how to answer that.

dialogue.content: あいまい過ぎる質問でしたね
dialogue.English: That was too vague of a question, wasn't it?

dialogue.content: いいえ
dialogue.English: No, not at all.

dialogue.content: お二人は良くお話しはなさりますか？
dialogue.English: Do the two of you talk often?

dialogue.content: そういうことですね
dialogue.English: Ah, I see—that's what you meant.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: これまでは何でも話していたと思います
dialogue.English: Until recently, I think we talked about everything.

dialogue.content: ケンカしたりとかはないです
dialogue.English: We don't really fight or anything.

dialogue.content: そうですよね彼氏さんのご職場で一緒に働いてもよいと思われたくらいですもの
dialogue.English: I can see that, especially since you were even willing to work with him at his job.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 結婚式がキャンセルになり
dialogue.English: After the wedding was canceled,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 色々バタバタして
dialogue.English: everything got hectic, and...

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: ここ数ヶ月は話せていないです
dialogue.English: We haven't been able to talk much these past few months.

dialogue.content: 仲がよろしいお二人にとってはお辛い時間でしたね
dialogue.English: That must have been a difficult time for a couple as close as you are.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 忙しくしているのが見えたので
dialogue.English: I could see he was very busy, so...

dialogue.content: 彼のことです
dialogue.English: I mean him.

dialogue.content: みどりさんが、お気を使われておられたのですね
dialogue.English: So you were being considerate of him.

dialogue.content: そうなりますね
dialogue.English: Yes, I suppose so.

dialogue.content: コロナの事では、色々と地球規模で考えなければならなく本当に辛かったですね普段ならなんでもお話し出来るお二人なのに
dialogue.English: With COVID, it's been a truly difficult time for everyone. Especially for the two of you, who can usually talk about anything.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: お二人の、
dialogue.English: For the two of you—

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes?

dialogue.content: この3年のお付き合いの月日の中で、彼氏さんの職場の方たちだったり、親御さん、妹さん関りになられて、だからこそお悩みも必然的に多くなってしまい、彼氏さんの収入面でもごふあんになり、結婚自体も考えなおすきっかけになってしまわれたかんじでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Over the course of your three-year relationship, you've become involved with his colleagues, his parents, and his sister. Is it that because of this, your worries have inevitably grown, you've become anxious about his income, and it's all led you to reconsider the marriage itself?

dialogue.content: と、
dialogue.English: Is that...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: そうです
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: 一番大きな原因としては良くお話しするお二人が、ここ暫くみどりさんがお気を使われお話し出来てない事も重要な感じですよね
dialogue.English: It seems that a major factor is that the two of you, who usually talk a lot, haven't been able to talk recently because you've been considerate of his situation. That feels quite significant, doesn't it?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 彼氏さんから、連絡はこないのですか？
dialogue.English: Does your fiancé not contact you?

dialogue.content: 連絡はきます
dialogue.English: He does contact me.

dialogue.content: 彼の気持ちは変わっていないような
dialogue.English: It seems his feelings haven't changed, and...

dialogue.content: それだけに
dialogue.English: Which is exactly why...

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Yes?

dialogue.content: 不安な気持ちを伝えるのは
dialogue.English: telling him how anxious I feel...

dialogue.content: 悪い気がしまして
dialogue.English: I feel bad about doing so.

dialogue.content: 躊躇してしまっておられるのですね
dialogue.English: So you're hesitating.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 彼のことが嫌いになったわけではなくて
dialogue.English: It's not that I've come to dislike him,

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: I understand.

dialogue.content: 結婚しようと思っていたときと状況が変わり
dialogue.English: it's just that the situation has changed from when we decided to get married.

dialogue.content: はい逆に彼氏さん思いですよね
dialogue.English: Yes, on the contrary, it shows how much you think of your fiancé.

dialogue.content: そうですか?
dialogue.English: Do you think so?

dialogue.content: ええ、とっても私にはそう感じます
dialogue.English: Yes, I really feel that way.

dialogue.content: 結婚を考え直している自分って
dialogue.English: This part of me that's reconsidering the marriage...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: M-hm.

dialogue.content: 冷たいな～とか思ってしまいます
dialogue.English: I feel like I'm being cold.

dialogue.content: あれあれ・・
dialogue.English: Oh my...

dialogue.content: 私は全く逆の印象でしたよ
dialogue.English: I actually had the complete opposite impression.

dialogue.content: そうですか
dialogue.English: You did?

dialogue.content: 彼を支えると決めたのに
dialogue.English: Even though I decided I would support him...

dialogue.content: みどりさんは、相手の立場におなりになられながら、自分の気持ちを押し殺して先読みと心配りができるお優しい方と思います
dialogue.English: Midori, I think you are a very kind person who is able to put herself in others' shoes, suppress your own feelings, and be considerate and thoughtful.

dialogue.content: そうですか
dialogue.English: You think so?

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 溜め込み過ぎてしまいお辛い気持ちの行き場がなくなっているのではないでしょうか？みどりさんご自身もお辛い時期なのに
dialogue.English: I wonder if you might be bottling up too much, leaving your difficult feelings with nowhere to go. Especially since this is a difficult time for you as well.

dialogue.content: そうかもしれません
dialogue.English: That may be true.

dialogue.content: このまま結婚しても大丈夫なのかなと
dialogue.English: I just wonder if it's okay to get married like this.

dialogue.content: みどりさんご自身の本来からあるお優しさが逆にご自身を追い詰めてる気がしますがいかかでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I feel that your innate kindness might actually be backing you into a corner. What do you think?

dialogue.content: そうかもしれません
dialogue.English: That might be the case.

dialogue.content: 確かに、彼氏さんの収入が大きく変わるとなると
dialogue.English: It's true that if your fiancé's income changes significantly,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 結婚への不安も増すとは思いますが、お二人ならお話をなさりながら上手に乗り越えていけそうに感じます
dialogue.English: it's natural that your anxiety about marriage would increase. But I feel that the two of you could work through it by talking together.

dialogue.content: はい。彼や彼の家族、職場の仲間のことは大切です。
dialogue.English: Yes. He, his family, and his colleagues are important to me.

dialogue.content: そうですよね、みどりさん本当にお人柄の良さが伝わってきます
dialogue.English: I can tell. Your good character really comes through.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: ここは、
dialogue.English: At this point,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes?

dialogue.content: もう、控えめになり過ぎずにご連絡がとれそうな時にご自身の不安だったお気持ちをお伝えしてはいかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: how about, instead of holding back so much, you try telling him about the anxieties you've been feeling when you have a chance to talk?

dialogue.content: みんな頑張っているのに
dialogue.English: But everyone is trying so hard...

dialogue.content: 自分だけ不安になって
dialogue.English: ...for me to be the only one feeling anxious.

dialogue.content: 一人で抱え込み過ぎては良くないですよ
dialogue.English: It's not good to carry it all by yourself.

dialogue.content: こんな気持ちを伝えるのは気が引けていました
dialogue.English: I've been hesitant to share these feelings.

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: You're right.

dialogue.content: 皆も頑張って来れているのは上手に吐き出しができているからだ。とは思いませんか？
dialogue.English: Don't you think that others are able to keep going because they're finding ways to let their feelings out?

dialogue.content: そうなんですね
dialogue.English: I see—that makes sense.

dialogue.content: 気が付きませんでした
dialogue.English: I hadn't realized that.

dialogue.content: ええ、みどりさんが思う以上にご自身は溜め込み過ぎてしまっている様に感じます
dialogue.English: Yes, I feel you're bottling up more than you realize.

dialogue.content: そうですか
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: これが当たり前でした
dialogue.English: This has been normal for me.

dialogue.content: みどりさんは、お優しく、気配り上手で相手の立場になり過ぎてしまうのかもしれませんね
dialogue.English: You're so kind and considerate that you might be putting yourself in others' shoes a little too much.

dialogue.content: では、
dialogue.English: Then,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ここがチャンスで新しいご自身のチャレンジですね勇気をもって抑えてたお気持ち伝えてみてください
dialogue.English: this is a chance for a new challenge for you. Please try to gather your courage and tell him the feelings you've been holding back.

dialogue.content: 良いきっかけをいただきました。
dialogue.English: You've given me a good opportunity.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 彼に話してみます
dialogue.English: I'll try talking to him.

dialogue.content: はい！是非！！みどりさんの新たな出発を応援しています
dialogue.English: Yes! Please do! I'm cheering for your new beginning, Midori.

dialogue.content: 新たな出発ですね
dialogue.English: A new beginning.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 新たな出発ですね＾＾
dialogue.English: A new beginning. :)

dialogue.content: 前向きに考えます
dialogue.English: I'll try to think positively.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: 勇気がいるでしょが頑張ってみてくださいねはい、前向きで！！
dialogue.English: It will take courage, but please give it a try—yes, with a positive mindset!

dialogue.content: 自分の気が付かなかったところを教えていただきありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you for pointing out things I hadn't noticed about myself.

dialogue.content: こちらこそ、お話をお聞かせ下さりありがとうございました
dialogue.English: No, thank you for sharing your story with me.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました今日はこれで終了となりますが、またなにかありましたらご相談にいらして下さい
dialogue.English: Thank you. This concludes our session for today, but please feel free to come back if anything else comes up.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: お世話になりました
dialogue.English: Thank you for your help.

dialogue.content: こちらこそですありがとうございました応援してますね！！
dialogue.English: Likewise—thank you. I'm rooting for you!

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: (お時間オーバーにお付き合い頂きありがとうございました)
dialogue.English: (Thank you for staying over our allotted time.)

dialogue.content: とんでもございません
dialogue.English: Not at all.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: (役とは言え素敵なお話しありがとうございました。でもとっても勉強になりました。ありがとうございました)
dialogue.English: (Even though it was a role-play, thank you for the wonderful conversation. It was a great learning experience for me. Thank you.)

dialogue.content: (また、お会い出来たらよろしくお願いいたします。お疲れさまでした。ありがとうございました。)
dialogue.English: (I hope we can meet again. You did a great job. Thank you.)

dialogue.content: こちらこそ大変勉強になりました。気分よく終われます。お疲れさまでした。
dialogue.English: It was a great learning experience for me as well. I feel good about how this ended. You did a great job.

dialogue.content: ありがとございます。お疲れさまでした。では失礼いたしますね。
dialogue.English: Thank you. You did a great job. I'll take my leave now.

dialogue.content: 失礼いたします。
dialogue.English: Goodbye.

dialogue.content: では、終了ボタンおさせていただきます。失礼いたします。
dialogue.English: I'll press the end button now. Goodbye.
